sections.content: To say 'our X', Hungarian adds a possessive suffix to the noun itself rather than using a separate possessive word. jegy ('ticket') plus -ünk gives jegyünk ('our ticket') -- vowel harmony picks -unk or -ünk.

items.english: Do we have a ticket? (lit. 'Is there our ticket?')

sections.content: There's no separate word for 'our' here -- it's built into jegyünk. Hungarian possession almost always works this way: the ending on the noun tells you who owns it.
